terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
Effective date: 18 August 2026

1. Service provider

The Services are provided by TASHIRA E-Visa & Tourism LLC-FZ, a private company licensed in Meydan Free Zone, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. TASHIRA is not a government authority and does not decide visa applications. Contact: admin@tashiraev.com, +971 50 210 1784, Meydan Grandstand, 6th Floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE.

2. Services and visa decisions

TASHIRA assists with reviewing, preparing and processing visa-related applications and communicating with relevant authorities or service providers. All decisions remain with the competent authority. Approval is not guaranteed, and payment or submission to TASHIRA does not mean that an application has been submitted to or approved by a government authority.

3. Customer responsibilities

You must provide accurate, complete and current information and authentic, valid documents. You must promptly provide any additional information requested. Incorrect, incomplete, expired, altered or misleading material may cause delay, refusal, cancellation or inability to provide the Service.

4. Processing estimates

Any stated processing period is an estimate, not a guarantee. Timing may depend on document completeness, eligibility, authority review, third-party or government systems, additional-document requests and circumstances outside TASHIRA's control.

5. Payment and service start

Payment must be successfully confirmed before operational processing. A paid application is initially Paid / Ready for Processing. The Service begins only after payment is confirmed, all required information and documents are complete, and TASHIRA actually starts reviewing or processing the application. That auditable transition is Processing Started. Payment alone does not mean processing has started.

6. Cancellation and refunds

The Refund/Cancellation Policy forms part of these Terms. Before Processing Started, a customer may request cancellation and a refund, subject only to actual, genuinely non-refundable third-party costs already incurred. Once processing starts, TASHIRA's service fee becomes non-refundable to the extent permitted by law. Visa refusal does not automatically create a refund entitlement.

7. Government and supplier charges

Amounts actually paid to an authority, supplier or other third party are subject to that provider's rules. A third-party amount is treated as non-refundable only if actually incurred and genuinely non-refundable to TASHIRA.

8. Corrections and documents

Before payment, permitted information and documents may be corrected, replaced or deleted. After payment but before processing, corrections or replacements may be requested and audit/version history may be preserved. After processing begins, controlled replacement requests apply and historical evidence is not silently overwritten. Changes after authority submission depend on what remains possible and cannot be guaranteed.

9. Liability and mandatory rights

TASHIRA is not responsible for an authority's decision or delays caused by customers, authorities, suppliers, system outages or events outside its reasonable control. Nothing excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. If a material TASHIRA error prevents delivery of the agreed Service, an appropriate remedy or full or partial refund may be considered under the circumstances and applicable law.

10. Privacy

Personal data is handled under the Privacy Policy.

11. Governing law and jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Dubai, United Arab Emirates, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rights or other rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

12. Electronic acceptance and versions

Checking the acceptance control or giving the explicit acceptance requested in the application flow constitutes electronic acceptance of the displayed Terms, Privacy Policy and Refund/Cancellation Policy. TASHIRA records the policy version, effective date, timestamp and application context. Later updates do not rewrite earlier acceptance records.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
Effective date: 18 August 2026

1. Who we are

TASHIRA E-Visa & Tourism LLC-FZ, Meydan Free Zone, Dubai, UAE, is a private visa/application service provider. Privacy requests: admin@tashiraev.com.

2. Data we process

We may process names and contact details; passport information and copies; photographs; residency and supporting documents; travel, visa and application information; applicant relationships; operational status/history; communications; security/audit data; and payment, invoice and transaction metadata.

3. Payment-card data

Stripe processes payment-card information. TASHIRA does not store full card numbers or CVC values. We may retain limited payment metadata such as status, amount, currency and Stripe transaction references.

4. Purposes

We use data to create, review, process, recover and track applications; communicate; make authorized submissions; process and evidence payments; issue invoices; prevent abuse; secure the Service; and meet accounting, dispute and legal obligations.

5. Sharing and providers

Data may be shared as reasonably necessary with relevant authorities and suppliers; Stripe; Resend; hosting, infrastructure and technical providers; professional advisers; and parties required by law. Documents are currently stored on access-controlled server filesystem infrastructure. Providers receive only data needed for their function.

6. Security

We use access controls, authorization checks, audit records and appropriate technical and organizational safeguards. No online system can be guaranteed completely secure.

7. Retention

  • Sensitive passport, photograph, residency and supporting-document files: 90 days after closure/completion, then eligible for secure deletion.
  • Operational application records: 2 years, with minimization where practical.
  • Financial, payment, invoice and accounting records: 7 years; this does not extend passport/photo file retention to seven years.
  • Security and audit logs: 2 years.

A legal hold, active dispute, chargeback or lawful requirement may extend retention only for related data. Normal deletion resumes when the hold ends.

8. Correction and deletion

You may request access, correction, replacement or deletion where applicable. After payment, audit/version history may be preserved; after processing starts, controlled replacement requests apply. Deletion may be limited by legal, accounting, tax, dispute, chargeback, claim or legal-hold obligations. Changes after authority submission cannot be guaranteed.

9. Cookies and future analytics

Essential cookies support security, sessions, language and application functions. Analytics or advertising technologies, including Google services, may be used only when enabled and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. They are not activated by this policy.

10. Contact

Email admin@tashiraev.com for privacy, correction or deletion requests. We may verify identity before acting.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.content:
Effective date: 18 August 2026

1. Processing-start definition

Payment alone does not mean processing has started. An application is first Paid / Ready for Processing. Processing starts only after payment is confirmed, required information/documents are complete, and TASHIRA actually begins review or processing. The transition is recorded as Processing Started.

2. Before processing starts

If you cancel after payment but before Processing Started, you may request a refund. TASHIRA may deduct only an actual third-party, government or supplier fee already incurred and genuinely non-refundable to TASHIRA.

3. After processing starts

Once TASHIRA begins processing, its service fee becomes non-refundable to the extent permitted by applicable law.

4. Third-party submission

Amounts actually paid to an authority, supplier or third party are subject to that provider's refund rules. TASHIRA cannot guarantee recovery of an amount genuinely non-refundable to it. Unincurred fees are not treated as non-refundable third-party costs.

5. Visa refusal and customer information

Visa refusal does not automatically create a refund entitlement because TASHIRA supplies application/processing services and does not decide or guarantee approval. Incorrect, incomplete or invalid customer information does not automatically create a refund entitlement.

6. Duplicate and failed payments

A confirmed duplicate payment will be refunded appropriately. A failed Stripe payment that was not captured does not require a refund. If funds were captured incorrectly, TASHIRA will review and refund where appropriate.

7. TASHIRA error

If a material TASHIRA error prevents delivery of the agreed Service, an appropriate full or partial refund or other remedy may be considered according to the circumstances and applicable mandatory rights.

8. Requests and method

Send the application reference to admin@tashiraev.com. Approved refunds are normally returned to the original payment method where practical and permitted.

9. Mandatory rights

Nothing in this Policy excludes consumer or other rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
